title: Content Brief
description: Harvested and adapted from ~/content-os/shared/schemas/content-brief.schema.json (Content OS retired 2026-08-21, see ~/.claude/harness/social/DECISIONS.md DEC-SM-002). The planning artifact between a brand's source material and a platform-native draft. 'lifecycle_status' replaces the original 'status' enum with the fuller Phase 1 vocabulary (engage/core/models.py LIFECYCLE_STATES). 'lead_magnet' is optional here, not required — it is a Capstacknick-specific funnel concept and this schema is brand-agnostic engine infrastructure (DESIGN.md: 'the engine contains zero brand language'). This schema governs the BRIEF only; the drafted TEXT is still independently governed by engage/safety/gates.py, unchanged.

id.description: Content record id. Matches the owning ContentRecord.id.

brand.description: ENGAGE slug (brands/<slug>/). Never inferred — always explicit.

pillar.description: Content pillar/topic cluster from the brand's config.yaml content_pillars, if any.

core_insight.description: The contrarian point of view. If it is not arguable, it is not an insight.

format.description: 'reel' covers any short vertical video (IG Reel / TikTok / YouTube Short). 'short' declares a title+description+media piece specifically, checked against a different constraint key set than reel's single caption.

lead_magnet.description: What gets handed over, or 'none'. Optional — see top-level description.

brand_voice.description: Pointer to the governing voice prompt, e.g. brands/<slug>/prompts/voice.md.

sources.description: Material IDs already in this brand's Store (engage material). Claims may trace ONLY to these — enforced by safety/gates.py numeric_provenance / claims_require_source, not by this schema.
